    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">什么是蓝牙的信令测试</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>板子需要去实验室测射频性能，所以需要提供信令测试固件；这里以杰理固件为例来说明信令测试相关；</p>
<h3>那么什么是信令测试？</h3>
<p>建立标准蓝牙连接，使用蓝牙标准的跳频算法同步跳频，维持连接；测试仪自动跟踪跳频通道测试射频状态；</p>
<blockquote>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 蓝牙空口<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;┌───────────────────┐<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;↓&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ↑<br>┌──────────┐&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ┌───────────┐<br>│ 蓝牙测试仪&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │ &lt;--&gt;&nbsp; │ AC696N DUT&nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>│ BT Tester&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>└──────────┘&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; └───────────┘<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│ Inquiry/Page &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│ Connection &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│ LMP&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│ L2CAP&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│ A2DP/HFP等&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│ EDR Data&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;└─────────────────┘</p>
</blockquote>
<h4>既然信令测试是测试蓝牙的标准流程，那么直接使用正式产品固件和信令测试固件有什么区别呢？</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>Bluetooth Core Specification 明确说明，BR/EDR Test Mode 用于测试 transmitter 和 receiver；</p>
<p>Test Mode 的控制配置使用特殊的 LMP 命令，例如 <code data-start="2198" data-end="2217">LMP_TEST_ACTIVATE</code> 和 <code data-start="2220" data-end="2238">LMP_TEST_CONTROL</code>。</p>
<p>正式产品固件要是没集成TestMode接口，那就需要单独固件测试；如果集成了TestMode接口，那就可以直接运行；</p>
</blockquote>
<p>如果是产品功能，互操作性测试，应该尽量使用正式产品固件；</p>
<p>如果需要专门的 Test Mode、HCI/Test Command、固定状态或特殊控制，那么应该使用专用测试固件；</p>
<h3>什么是非信令测试？</h3>
<p>不建立蓝牙连接，通过串口工具对DUT待测设备的射频参数进行设置，然后直接启动射频电路进行工作；测试仪直接测试RF；</p>
<blockquote>通过串口工具设置蓝牙设备的射频参数，然后蓝牙设备直接工作在对应频道<br>Channel = 39<br>Packet Type = 3-DH5<br>Power = X dBm<br>Payload = PRBS9</blockquote>
<blockquote>使用测试仪直接测试对应频偏RF<br>AC696N DUT &nbsp;[ Device Under Test ]<br>&nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>&nbsp; &nbsp;│ 2441 MHz<br>&nbsp; &nbsp;│ EDR 3M<br>&nbsp; &nbsp;↓<br>RF Tester</blockquote>
<h4>非信令测试串口工具</h4>
<p>  <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1371863/202609/1371863-20260903192403566-178605113.png" alt="image" height="489" width="620"></p>
